objective: Test whether the disposable P2 route-q4 body benefits from the QKV overlay without touching P0 or KIMI-U001.

measurement_contract.prompt: Generate a numbered list from 1 through 120. Put each number and a single letter on its own line. Do not stop early.

summary.reason: The median is approximately 100 TPS but one of three long controls falls to 81.9 TPS and the lane remains co-resident with U001.

decision.reason: Removing the packed QKV overlay improved the long-control median relative to the repaired all-overlay run; QKV packing is not a safe route to 250 TPS.
decision.next_frontier: native route-major MLA consumer or a measured body-level representation change
